title: Validate a list of labels
prompt: Write `labelsOnly(value: unknown): boolean`. Return `true` when `value` is an array that holds only strings. An empty array counts. A plain string, or an array with any non-string item, gives `false`.
hints: Check that `value` is an array before looking at items.
Every item needs its own `typeof` check.
An empty array has no bad items, so it passes.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Checks only that it is an array.

feedback: Check that `value` is an array before looking at items.
